source.title: White Rann Of Kachchh, District Kachchh

header.one_line: Gujarat, from Bhuj to the salt desert at Dhordo and across to Dholavira

rules.title: White Rann: entry permit, online or at checkpost
rules.detail: Book online or at Bhirandiyara checkpost; the lead traveller uploads identity proof. Adults 100 rupees, children six to twelve 50 rupees, two-wheelers listed at no charge.
rules.set_by: Kachchh district administration, Government of Gujarat

source.title: Online permit for Rann of Kutch

history.change: District administration launched online permits on a separate website; checkpost permits continued. Two-wheelers were charged a fee at that time.

source.title: Online permit system for visit to White Rann of Kutch launched by Collector with dedicated website

rules.title: Online permit is for Indian nationals only
rules.detail: The government portal accepts Indian nationals only. An operator says foreign visitors give passport and visa details and should allow more time.
rules.set_by: Kachchh district administration, Government of Gujarat

source.title: Online permit for Rann of Kutch

rules.title: Kalo Dungar: carry the same permit onward
rules.detail: An operator says the White Rann permit is checked again at a second checkpost on the way to Kalo Dungar. No government order was found.

source.title: Rann of Kutch Entry Permit: The Complete Guide

rules.title: India Bridge: civilians stop here without special permission
rules.detail: Past India Bridge near Khavda the area is closed to civilians; entry needs special permission from the Border Security Force. No government order was found.

rules.title: Khavda to Dholavira road: original identity card checked
rules.detail: A travel site says an army checkpost near Khavda checks original photo identity, the road has no entry fee, and motorcycles are allowed. No government order found.

season.note: The Rann is a shallow seasonal wetland after the monsoon and dries to white salt by October or November; winter is the riding season.

authorities.office: Kachchh district administration, Government of Gujarat
authorities.announces: Issues White Rann entry permits online and at the Bhirandiyara checkpost
authorities.stretch: Bhirandiyara to Dhordo and the White Rann

source.title: Online permit for Rann of Kutch

authorities.announces: Decides on special permission to go beyond India Bridge
authorities.stretch: India Bridge and the border area north of Khavda

hazards.title: No fuel on the Khavda to Dholavira road
hazards.detail: No pumps on the 30 kilometre stretch across the Rann; fill up at Bhuj or Khavda first.

hazards.title: Rann under water after the monsoon
hazards.detail: The salt flats hold water about half a metre to one and a half metres deep until they dry in October or November.

gaps: The official permit page gives no checkpost hours and does not name the places the permit covers beyond 'the Rann area'.

No official page was found for the rule at India Bridge or for how to ask the Border Security Force for permission beyond it. A forum thread that could not be opened (https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowTopic-g303878-i11398-k7007777-Need_info_on_permits-Bhuj_Kutch_District_Gujarat.html) says no permit is needed up to the bridge and that permission to cross is given at the district office or the Border Security Force office in Bhuj.
The official Kachchh district pages for the White Rann and Dholavira say nothing about permits, timings or fees.
The highway number of the Khavda to Dholavira road was not sourced.
Usual number of riding days: no source found.
No source found for summer heat figures in Kutch.
Videos: the pages give upload dates, not filming dates, so 'filmed' is filled only where the title names a date. Uploads, in order: 2024-01, 2025-11.
